name: media-tools
description: Batch video compression and output verification workflows maintained by Agent Toolkit.

interface.shortDescription: Batch-compress and verify local video files.
interface.longDescription: Batch-compress MP4, MOV, and M4V files to a consistent H.264/AAC profile, safely handle filenames and resumable outputs, and verify every result with ffprobe.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compress the videos in this folder and verify the outputs.
